records.jp: うわ、何ここ…………？
records.en_original: Whoa, where are we...?
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, where are we...?
records.en: Whoa, where are we...?

records.jp: これは、雫世界の外観イメージだね
records.en_original: This is what the exterior of Oasis looks like.
records.en_auxiliary: This is what the exterior of Oasis looks like.
records.en: This is what the exterior of Oasis looks like.

records.jp: ●カット
これが雫世界だとすれば、<CR>あたりが真っ暗なのって――
records.en_original: If that's Oasis, the darkness surrounding it is...
records.en_auxiliary: If that's Oasis, the darkness surrounding it is...
records.en: If that's Oasis, the darkness surrounding it is...

records.jp: 何もない。無が広がってるってことだよ
records.en_original: Nothingness. And it's spreading.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothingness. And it's spreading.
records.en: Nothingness. And it's spreading.

records.jp: …………本当に、もうわたしたち以外には<CR>何も、誰も存在しないんですか？
records.en_original: Does that mean we're the only people in existence...?
records.en_auxiliary: Does that mean we're the only people in existence...?
records.en: Does that mean we're the only people in existence...?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yes...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes...
records.en: Yes...

records.jp: ……心のどこかで、そうでなければいいのにって、<CR>ずっと思ってました
records.en_original: Somewhere deep down, I was hoping it wasn't true...
records.en_auxiliary: Somewhere deep down, I was hoping it wasn't true...
records.en: Somewhere deep down, I was hoping it wasn't true...

records.jp: でも、やっぱり……これが真実なんですね
records.en_original: But I suppose it's the truth...
records.en_auxiliary: But I suppose it's the truth...
records.en: But I suppose it's the truth...

records.jp: 家族も、友人も、大切な仲間も、<CR>もうこの世界にはいない……
records.en_original: Family, friends, everyone we care about is no longer in this world...
records.en_auxiliary: Family, friends, everyone we care about is no longer in this world...
records.en: Family, friends, everyone we care about is no longer in this world...

records.jp: そ、そんな……嫌だよ、私……
records.en_original: N-no...that's...I can't...
records.en_auxiliary: N-no...that's...I can't...
records.en: N-no...that's...I can't...

records.jp: ま、まだ何か方法があるはずだよ！<CR>みんなを取り戻す、何か……
records.en_original: There has to be way! There must be some way to bring everyone back...
records.en_auxiliary: There has to be way! There must be some way to bring everyone back...
records.en: There has to be way! There must be some way to bring everyone back...

records.jp: 何かって……？
records.en_original: Like what?
records.en_auxiliary: Like what?
records.en: Like what?

records.jp: ………………いや、ごめん。<CR>何も考えずに言った
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry, I don't know. I spoke without thinking.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry, I don't know. I spoke without thinking.
records.en: ...I'm sorry, I don't know. I spoke without thinking.

records.jp: やっぱり、私のせいで、こんな…………
records.en_original: This is all my fault...
records.en_auxiliary: This is all my fault...
records.en: This is all my fault...

records.en_original: ...That's not true.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's not true.
records.en: ...That's not true.

records.jp: ずっと、違うって言ってあげたかった
records.en_original: We've been wanting to tell you that for so long.
records.en_auxiliary: We've been wanting to tell you that for so long.
records.en: We've been wanting to tell you that for so long.

records.jp: ユズ、ライム……？
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime...?
records.en: Yuzu, Lime...?

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.

records.jp: たしかに今、<CR>ユズたちは絶望的な状況かもしれない
records.en_original: Our situation now may seem hopeless...
records.en_auxiliary: Our situation now may seem hopeless...
records.en: It is true that Yuzu and Lime may be in a hopeless situation right now.

records.jp: 大切な人たちを失って、<CR>もう、ユズたちしか残っていなくて……
records.en_original: We've lost everyone we love, and we're the only ones left.
records.en_auxiliary: We've lost everyone we love, and we're the only ones left.
records.en: They've lost the people they cherish, and only Yuzu and Lime remain...

records.jp: ●カット
だけど、どうにかこの世界で生きてる。<CR>生きて、希望をつないでる
records.en_original: But we're still alive in this world. As long as we live, there will be hope.
records.en_auxiliary: But we're still alive in this world. As long as we live, there will be hope.
records.en: But we're still alive in this world. As long as we live, there will be hope.

records.jp: それって、あの日ヒナちゃんが……<CR>ライムたちと一緒に、決断してくれたからなんだよ
records.en_original: You were there when we all made our decision that day...
records.en_auxiliary: You were there when we all made our decision that day...
records.en: That is because on that day, Hina-chan, you made the decision together with Lime and Yuzu.

records.jp: あの決断がなかったら、<CR>ユズたちの世界はなくなってたから
records.en_original: If we hadn't, our world would have disappeared.
records.en_auxiliary: If we hadn't, our world would have disappeared.
records.en: Without that decision, Yuzu and Lime's world would have disappeared.

records.jp: ユズ……
records.en_original: Yuzu...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu...
records.en: Yuzu...

records.jp: ライムたちが雫世界に<CR>希望を託したのだってそうなんだよ
records.en_original: That's why we put our hope in Oasis.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why we put our hope in Oasis.
records.en: The same is true of Lime and Yuzu entrusting their hope to Oasis.

records.jp: 絶対に無理だって状況でも抗ったのは、<CR>ヒナちゃんが想いを、世界を、つないでくれたから
records.en_original: We fought back even against impossible odds because of the feelings we received from you.
records.en_auxiliary: We fought back even against impossible odds because of the feelings we received from you.
records.en: Even when it seemed absolutely impossible, we resisted because you connected our feelings and our world, Hina-chan.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんがつないでくれた希望を諦めたくない。<CR>その想いがあったからライムたちは今、ここにいる
records.en_original: The only reason we are here now is because we didn't want to give up the hope you had given us.
records.en_auxiliary: The only reason we are here now is because we didn't want to give up the hope you had given us.
records.en: Lime and Yuzu are here now because they did not want to give up the hope you connected for them, Hina-chan.

records.jp: ……ヒナちゃん、一人で背負わせてごめん。<CR>遅くなったけど……ようやく言える
records.en_original: Hina, we're sorry you had to deal with everything on your own for so long. I'm glad we can finally say that.
records.en_auxiliary: Hina, we're sorry you had to deal with everything on your own for so long. I'm glad we can finally say that.
records.en: Hina-chan, we're sorry you had to deal with everything on your own for so long. I'm glad we can finally say that.

records.jp: あの日の決意は、ヒナちゃんだけのものじゃない。<CR>ヒナちゃんとユズたち、三人のものだよ
records.en_original: Your decision that day wasn't just yours, it was mine and Yuzu's as well. We all share responsibility for it.
records.en_auxiliary: Your decision that day wasn't just yours, it was mine and Yuzu's as well. We all share responsibility for it.
records.en: The resolve we made that day wasn't yours alone, Hina-chan. It belonged to all three of us—to you, Yuzu, and Lime.

records.jp: だから、全部三人で分け合おう？<CR>これからはライムたちも、一緒に背負うから
records.en_original: So let's share this burden between the three of us.
records.en_auxiliary: So let's share this burden between the three of us.
records.en: So let's share everything among the three of us. From now on, Lime and Yuzu will bear it with you.

records.jp: 二人とも……
records.en_original: Yuzu... Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu... Lime...
records.en: Yuzu... Lime...

records.jp: おかえり、ユズ。ライム
records.en_original: Welcome back, Yuzu. Lime.
records.en_auxiliary: Welcome back, Yuzu. Lime.
records.en: Welcome back, Yuzu. Lime.

records.jp: ……ただいま、ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: It's good to be back, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: It's good to be back, Hina!
records.en: It's good to be back, Hina-chan!

records.jp: ライム……
records.en_original: Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Lime...
records.en: Lime...
